Corrected Reflectance.name: VIIRS NOAA-20 True Color
Corrected Reflectance.description: True-color imagery from VIIRS on NOAA-20 satellite. 375m resolution, complements SNPP coverage.

Corrected Reflectance.name: VIIRS SNPP True Color
Corrected Reflectance.description: True-color imagery from VIIRS on Suomi NPP. 375m resolution. Near-real-time, available within ~3 hours of acquisition.

Corrected Reflectance.name: MODIS Terra True Color
Corrected Reflectance.description: True-color corrected reflectance from MODIS on Terra. 250m resolution, morning overpass (~10:30am local). Longest continuous daily record from 2000.

Corrected Reflectance.name: MODIS Aqua True Color
Corrected Reflectance.description: True-color corrected reflectance from MODIS on Aqua. 250m resolution, afternoon overpass (~1:30pm local). Pairs with Terra for fuller daily coverage.

Corrected Reflectance.name: MODIS Terra False Color (7-2-1)
Corrected Reflectance.description: False-color imagery mapping SWIR/NIR/Red bands. Burn scars appear red-brown, snow and ice appear vivid blue, vegetation is bright green. Useful for fire and flood analysis.

Temperature.name: Surface Air Temperature L3 (Day)
Temperature.description: L3 gridded daytime air temperature at 2m above surface from AIRS. Gap-free daily global coverage at ~1 degree resolution — no orbital banding. Preferred over L2 for full-coverage views.

Temperature.name: Surface Air Temperature L3 (Night)
Temperature.description: L3 gridded nighttime air temperature at 2m above surface from AIRS. Gap-free daily global coverage at ~1 degree resolution — no orbital banding.

Temperature.name: Surface Air Temperature L2 (Day) [swath]
Temperature.description: Raw daytime swath air temperature at 2m from AIRS. Shows individual orbital passes with banding gaps — use L3 version for gap-free coverage. Useful for seeing raw satellite geometry.

Temperature.name: Surface Air Temperature L2 (Night) [swath]
Temperature.description: Raw nighttime swath air temperature from AIRS. Orbital banding visible — use L3 version for gap-free coverage. Night pass partially fills gaps left by day pass.

Temperature.name: Land Surface Temperature L3 (Terra, Day)
Temperature.description: L3 gridded daytime land surface temperature from MODIS Terra. 1km resolution, gap-filled daily composite. Shows ground temperature rather than air temperature — useful for drought, urban heat, and vegetation stress.

Temperature.name: Land Surface Temperature (Terra, Day) [swath]
Temperature.description: Raw swath daytime land surface temperature from MODIS Terra. 1km resolution. Orbital banding visible. Use L3 version above for gap-free daily coverage.

Temperature.name: Land Surface Temperature (Aqua, Day) [swath]
Temperature.description: Raw swath afternoon land surface temperature from MODIS Aqua. 1km resolution. Use alongside Terra for diurnal temperature comparison.

Vegetation.name: NDVI 16-Day Composite (Terra L3)
Vegetation.description: Normalised Difference Vegetation Index from MODIS Terra L3, 16-day composite. Values range from -1 (no vegetation) to +1 (dense vegetation). 1km resolution. Excellent for monitoring drought, crop stress, and seasonal greenness.

Vegetation.name: EVI 16-Day Composite (Terra L3)
Vegetation.description: Enhanced Vegetation Index from MODIS Terra L3, 16-day composite. More sensitive than NDVI in high-biomass areas and reduces atmospheric and soil background influences. 1km resolution.

Snow & Ice.name: Snow Cover Daily (Terra, L3 NDSI)
Snow & Ice.description: Daily snow cover from MODIS Terra at 500m resolution using the Normalised Difference Snow Index (NDSI). Shows presence and extent of snow on land and ice on water bodies.

Snow & Ice.name: Snow Cover Daily (Aqua, L3 NDSI)
Snow & Ice.description: Daily snow cover from MODIS Aqua at 500m resolution using NDSI. Afternoon overpass complements Terra for fuller daily coverage, particularly useful where morning pass is cloud-obscured.

Precipitation & Soil Moisture.name: Precipitation Rate (30-min, GPM)
Precipitation & Soil Moisture.description: Global precipitation measurement from GPM satellite constellation. Shows rainfall intensity in near real-time. 10km resolution, 30-minute updates. Use a datetime timestamp e.g. 2024-11-29T23:30:00Z.

Water Vapor & Clouds.name: Water Vapor (MODIS Aqua, Day)
Water Vapor & Clouds.description: Total column water vapor from MODIS Aqua. Shows atmospheric moisture content. 5km resolution, useful for weather forecasting and tracking storm systems.

Water Vapor & Clouds.name: Cloud Top Temperature (Aqua, Day)
Water Vapor & Clouds.description: Temperature at cloud tops from MODIS Aqua. Colder values indicate taller clouds and potentially severe weather. 5km resolution.

Water Vapor & Clouds.name: Cloud Top Temperature (Terra, Day)
Water Vapor & Clouds.description: Cloud top temperature from MODIS Terra. Helps identify storm systems and convective activity. 5km resolution.

Ocean & Water Quality.name: Sea Surface Temperature (MUR, L4)
Ocean & Water Quality.description: Multi-sensor blended L4 sea surface temperature. Gap-free daily global coverage at 1km resolution. Shows ocean temperature patterns, upwelling zones, and thermal fronts. Uses MUR algorithm combining multiple satellite sensors.

Ocean & Water Quality.name: Ocean Chlorophyll-a (MODIS Aqua L2)
Ocean & Water Quality.description: Ocean chlorophyll-a concentration from MODIS Aqua. Proxy for phytoplankton biomass and ocean primary productivity. 1km resolution. High values (green) indicate algal blooms; low values (blue) indicate clear open ocean.

Aerosols & Air Quality.name: Aerosol Optical Depth (MODIS Combined)
Aerosols & Air Quality.description: Combined aerosol optical depth from Terra and Aqua MODIS. Shows air quality, dust storms, and smoke from fires. Higher values indicate more aerosols. 10km resolution, daily.

Aerosols & Air Quality.name: UV Aerosol Index (OMI)
Aerosols & Air Quality.description: Absorbing aerosol index from OMI using UV measurements. Positive values indicate dust or smoke events. 13km resolution, daily. Good for tracking Saharan dust and wildfire smoke transport.

_notes.bandingIssue: L2 layers (AIRS_L2_*, MODIS_Terra_Land_Surface_Temp_Day) show orbital swath gaps because they are single-pass products. Use the corresponding L3 layers for gap-free views. To partially fill gaps on L2 layers, stack day+night passes or request tiles across 2 consecutive dates.
_notes.timeFormat: Most layers use YYYY-MM-DD. IMERG and GHRSST_MUR require full ISO datetime e.g. 2024-11-29T23:30:00Z.
_notes.l3Upgrades: AIRS_L2 surface temperature replaced with AIRS_L3_Surface_Air_Temperature_Daily_Day/Night as primary layers. MODIS_Terra_L3_Land_Surface_Temp_Daily_Day added as primary LST layer. L2 swath layers retained as secondary options.
_notes.ndviEvi: MODIS NDVI/EVI use 8-day composites — set time to the start of an 8-day period e.g. 2024-11-09 (check MODIS 8-day tile schedule). Not every daily date will return tiles.
_notes.layerValidation: All 24 layers verified serving tiles (HTTP 200) against GIBS epsg3857/best as of 2026-06-09. 4 layers removed (thermal anomalies, night lights) — they exist in GIBS directory but never return tile data.
_notes.tileMatrixSets: Each layer supports exactly one GoogleMapsCompatible_LevelX — verified per layer with multiple tile coordinates.
_notes.removedLayers: VIIRS_SNPP_Thermal_Anomalies_375m_Day, VIIRS_SNPP_Thermal_Anomalies_375m_Night, MODIS_Combined_Thermal_Anomalies_All, VIIRS_SNPP_DayNightBand_ENCC — never serve tiles in epsg3857 WMTS endpoint.
